capabilities: Compose timestamped Markdown posts into a newest-first feed with a composer
Reply to posts in threaded, branch-aware note trees
Highlight, name, and edit notes with feed keyboard shortcuts
Generate scoped AI reflections through the AI Providers plugin
Export threads and branches as timestamped Markdown rows
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; the README is mostly a changelog for 0.2.1 plus navigation details.
intentEvidence: an independent project inspired by Pile; it is not affiliated with or endorsed by Pile
problem: Obsidian has no built-in feed-style journaling view where quick posts in one folder become a threaded, browsable stream.

relations.evidence: in the spirit of Pile by Udara Jay
optional AI replies via the AI Providers plugin

summary: Micro-journal that keeps timestamped Markdown posts in one vault folder, with a feed, threaded replies, and optional AI reflections.
